errorCodes.meaning: The community has no storage config with this identifier.
Rooms are still assigned to the config. Assign each to another config first (vtc/rooms/storage/assign). `details.rooms` is the count.
The config is the community's default. Make another config the default first.

A migration of room files onto the config (vtc/rooms/storage/migrate, `toConfig` naming it) is `queued`, `running` or `paused`. Let those migrations finish, or move the rooms' files elsewhere, first. `details.migrations` is the count.

StorageConfigId.description: A storage config's identifier, chosen by the administrator who creates it and immutable thereafter: lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens, at most 64 characters (`eu-s3-primary`, `walrus-main`). Unique within the community. Never reused after a config is retired, because blobs name their config by this value.
